identity.name: Spoke Ghivine
identity.archetype: Jewel & Luxury (Cultural) mixed with Electric & Neon (Tech)
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix ancient heritage aesthetics with futuristic tech UI.
Emotion First: Evoke mystery and discovery through dark mode and lighting.
Content is King: The 3D spaces and artifacts are the heroes; UI is the frame.
Negative Space: Use deep black space to let the content breathe.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Cultural context

body.usage: UI elements, Descriptions, CMS data, Navigation

mono.usage: Technical data, Coordinates, SDK debug info

layout_strategies.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A for Gallery, Mode B for CMS)
layout_strategies.spacing: Generous (2x standard). Use p-8, p-12, p-24.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(6,182,212,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-4 border border-white/10

cards.feature: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-500
cards.cms: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border shadow-sm

inputs.style: bg-black/20 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-12

matterport_overlay.controls: pointer-events-auto bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 text-white

home.structure: Hero (Full height, video/3D bg) -> Intro (Text + Logos) -> Spaces Grid (Bento) -> Footer
home.key_elements: Animated entrance for logos, Parallax scroll for ruins images, 'Enter Experience' primary CTA.

matterport_viewer.structure: Full-screen iframe/SDK container. Overlay UI for: Language Switcher, POI List (Sidebar), Audio Controls.
matterport_viewer.interaction: Sidebar should be collapsible. POIs in sidebar should trigger camera fly-to in 3D model.

cms_admin.style: Clean, functional, high contrast. Use Shadcn Data Tables for Space/POI lists. Forms for editing translations.
cms_admin.features: Language tabs for text fields (IT, EN, FR, DE). Image upload dropzones.

universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios > 4.5:1 for text. Use aria-labels for all icon buttons.
universal_guidelines.motion: Use framer-motion for page transitions. Stagger children for lists. Smooth scroll (Lenis) is mandatory.
universal_guidelines.responsive: Mobile-first. Stack grids on mobile. Hide non-essential 3D elements on small screens if performance lags.
universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'nav-home-link', 'viewer-play-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, @radix-ui/react-*, sonner.
2. Configure Tailwind with the custom colors and fonts defined above.
3. Create the Layout component with the global Navbar and Footer.
4. Implement the Matterport Viewer component using the SDK (mock if SDK fails locally, but structure for real integration).
5. Build the CMS pages using Shadcn components (Table, Form, Dialog, Tabs).
6. Ensure the 'Dark Mode' is default and permanent (force 'dark' class on html/body).
7. Use the provided Image URLs for the initial content population.
